new_entities.name: CHAPSPaymentExecution
new_entities.description: Records the full lifecycle of a CHAPS payment instruction from initiation through to Bank of England RTGS settlement. Owned by SVC-009 (Domestic Payments, CAP-003). Distinct from ENT-009 (PaymentExecution, FPS) because CHAPS carries mandatory ISO 20022 enhanced data fields (Purpose Code, LEI, structured address) and uses RTGS-specific settlement tracking (UETR, RTGS message reference). This entity is the authoritative record of CHAPS settlement status.

fields.name: chaps_execution_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated by SVC-009. Immutable after creation. Internal identifier.

fields.name: payment_intent_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → ENT-008 (PaymentIntent) in SVC-001. References the originating payment intent. Immutable after creation.

fields.name: uetr
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 20022 Unique End-to-End Transaction Reference. UUID v4 format (xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx). System-generated by SVC-009. Immutable after creation. Included in pacs.008 MsgId field. Used for RTGS tracing and customer reference.

fields.name: rtgs_message_reference
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required after RTGS acceptance. The message ID assigned by Bank of England RTGS. Max 35 characters. Immutable after settlement.

fields.name: originator_account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → ENT-004 (Account) in SVC-001. The debited account. Cross-capability reference — SVC-009 holds the account_id as a reference key only; SVC-001 owns the Account entity.

fields.name: beneficiary_sort_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit sort code, format XX-XX-XX. Validated against Vocalink EISCD at PH-077. Immutable after authorisation.

fields.name: beneficiary_account_number
fields.validation_rule: Required. 8-digit account number. Validated against EISCD modulus checking rules at PH-077. Immutable after authorisation.

fields.name: beneficiary_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. Max 140 characters. As provided by PER-001 at payment initiation. Used in CoP check and pacs.008 creditor name field.

fields.name: beneficiary_iban
fields.validation_rule: Optional. IBAN format (GB + 2 check digits + 4-letter bank code + 6-digit sort code + 8-digit account number). Derived from beneficiary_sort_code and beneficiary_account_number at submission time.

computed_from.logic: IBAN = 'GB' + MOD97 check digits + bank_code(sort_code) + sort_code_digits + account_number. Computed at pacs.008 message construction time.

fields.name: beneficiary_lei
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when beneficiary is a corporate entity from 1 May 2025 (GOV-003-R03). ISO 17442 LEI format: 20 alphanumeric characters. Null for individual accounts (e.g. solicitor personal client account). Must be validated against GLEIF database if provided.

fields.name: amount_gbp
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2 decimal places. No statutory maximum for CHAPS. Bank internal monitoring threshold: ≥ £10,000 triggers enhanced monitoring flag. Must be > 0.00.

fields.name: purpose_code
fields.validation_rule: Required from 1 May 2025 (GOV-003-R03). ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code. For property purchase: 'PROP'. Validated against approved code list at PH-081 pacs.008 construction. Enum enforced.

fields.name: payment_reference
fields.validation_rule: Required. Max 35 characters (ISO 20022 field constraint). Free text entered by PER-001. Used as pacs.008 RemittanceInformation field. Typically contains property address or transaction reference.

fields.name: cop_result
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: match | partial_match | no_match | unavailable. Set at PH-078. Immutable after authorisation. Stored for audit (GOV-003-R02 Consumer Duty evidence).

fields.name: cop_checked_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Timestamp of CoP result receipt. Immutable.

fields.name: customer_cop_confirmation
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when cop_result IN (partial_match, no_match). Enum: confirmed_proceed | cancelled. Immutable. Audit evidence that PER-001 acknowledged the mismatch risk.

fields.name: sanctions_screening_result
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: clear | hit | pending | unavailable. Set at PH-079. Immutable after payment reaches authorised status.

fields.name: sanctions_screening_reference
fields.validation_rule: Required. Reference ID from SVC-051 screening result. Used for audit trail. Opaque string — format determined by screening engine.

fields.name: authorised_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when submission_status != pending. ISO 8601 UTC. Set when PER-001 completes SCA at PH-080.

fields.name: sca_reference
fields.validation_rule: Required. Reference from SVC-100 SCA challenge. Evidence of PSR 2017 Reg 100 dynamic linking compliance. Immutable.

fields.name: submission_status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: pending | submitted | accepted | rejected | settled | failed. Transitions: pending (created) → submitted (pacs.008 sent to RTGS) → accepted (RTGS confirmation received) → settled (settlement confirmed). rejected/failed are terminal failure states.

fields.name: submitted_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when submission_status >= submitted. ISO 8601 UTC.

fields.name: settled_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when submission_status = settled. ISO 8601 UTC. The definitive settlement timestamp from Bank of England RTGS confirmation.

fields.name: rejection_reason
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when submission_status = rejected or failed. ISO 20022 reason code from RTGS rejection message or internal error code. Max 35 chars.

fields.name: is_mortgage_completion_payment
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false. Set to true when purpose_code = PROP and payment is linked to an active MortgageAccount via mortgage_account_id. Triggers MortgageCompletionPaymentConfirmed event publication on settlement.

fields.name: mortgage_account_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when is_mortgage_completion_payment = true. FK → ENT-016 (MortgageAccount) in SVC-002. Cross-capability reference — SVC-009 holds the ID as a reference key only.

fields.name: enhanced_monitoring_flag
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false. Set to true when amount_gbp >= 10000. Triggers enhanced real-time monitoring in SVC-014.

fields.name: chaps_cutoff_missed
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false. Set to true when payment is authorised but CHAPS bank cut-off passes before submission. Triggers EXC-004 path and CHAPSPaymentFailed publication.

relationships.description: CHAPSPaymentExecution derived from one PaymentIntent (ENT-008) in SVC-001. Cross-capability reference via payment_intent_id.
CHAPSPaymentExecution debits one Account (ENT-004) in SVC-001. Cross-capability reference via originator_account_id.
Conditional: CHAPSPaymentExecution may be linked to one MortgageAccount (ENT-016) in SVC-002 when is_mortgage_completion_payment = true. Cross-capability reference.

design_decisions.decision: CHAPSPaymentExecution is a separate entity from ENT-009 (PaymentExecution, FPS).
design_decisions.rationale: See DD-JRN028-02 in journey-detail.json. CHAPS mandatory fields (purpose_code, LEI, UETR, RTGS message reference, cop_result, structured address) diverge from FPS. Merging would create a sparse entity with ~40% nullable fields depending on rail.

design_decisions.decision: cop_result and customer_cop_confirmation are stored on CHAPSPaymentExecution (not on ENT-008 PaymentIntent).
design_decisions.rationale: CoP is a CHAPS/FPS-specific compliance check. Storing it on the payment execution entity keeps the compliance evidence close to the settlement record. ENT-008 (PaymentIntent) is a CAP-001 entity; CoP evidence belongs in CAP-003.

new_entities.name: CHAPSPaymentIntent
new_entities.description: A CHAPS-specific payment intent record created in SVC-001 when PER-001 initiates a CHAPS payment. Extends the pattern of ENT-008 (PaymentIntent) but is a separate entity because CHAPS initiation requires additional fields (purpose_code, beneficiary_lei, is_mortgage_completion_payment) that are not present on the generic PaymentIntent. Owned by SVC-001 (Retail Banking Core, CAP-001). SVC-001 publishes CHAPSPaymentIntentCreated (EVT-108); SVC-009 creates CHAPSPaymentExecution (ENT-052) on receipt.

fields.name: chaps_intent_id
fields.validation_rule: RFC 4122 UUID v4. System-generated. Immutable.

fields.name: customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → ENT-001 (Customer). Immutable.

fields.name: account_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. FK → ENT-004 (Account). Must reference an account with status = active. Immutable.

fields.name: beneficiary_sort_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. 6-digit sort code. Validated against Vocalink EISCD.

fields.name: beneficiary_account_number
fields.validation_rule: Required. 8-digit account number. Validated against EISCD modulus.

fields.name: beneficiary_name
fields.validation_rule: Required. Max 140 characters.

fields.name: beneficiary_lei
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required for corporate beneficiaries from 1 May 2025.

fields.name: amount_gbp
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal, max 2dp. Must be <= Account.available_balance at authorisation.

fields.name: purpose_code
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 20022 ExternalPurpose1Code. Default for this journey: PROP.

fields.name: payment_reference
fields.validation_rule: Required. Max 35 characters.

fields.name: is_mortgage_completion_payment
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default false. Set to true by channel when initiated from mortgage completion journey context.

fields.name: mortgage_account_id
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when is_mortgage_completion_payment = true. FK → ENT-016.

fields.name: status
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: initiated | cop_pending | cop_complete | sanctions_pending | sanctions_complete | authorised | executed | completed | failed | cancelled. Strict forward-only state machine.

fields.name: initiated_at
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 UTC. Set at CHAPSPaymentIntentCreated.

fields.name: channel
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: web | mobile. Set from the originating channel.

fields.name: reserved_funds_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Set when status = authorised and funds are reserved. ISO 8601 UTC.

relationships.description: CHAPSPaymentIntent belongs to one Customer (ENT-001). Same-capability (CAP-001).

design_decisions.decision: CHAPSPaymentIntent is a separate entity from ENT-008 (PaymentIntent, FPS).
design_decisions.rationale: ENT-008 was designed around FPS initiation (PaymentIntentCreated EVT-P01 → SVC-013 fraud scoring → SVC-051 sanctions). CHAPS initiation has a different orchestration: CoP check first, then sanctions, then SCA at authorisation. Different state machine and different required fields. Extending ENT-008 would require making the FPS-specific fields nullable for CHAPS and vice versa.

referenced_existing_entities.name: Customer
referenced_existing_entities.usage: PER-001 identity. customer_id referenced on CHAPSPaymentIntent (ENT-053). Read by SVC-001 for channel authentication and audit.

referenced_existing_entities.name: Account
referenced_existing_entities.usage: Source account for CHAPS debit. account_id referenced on both ENT-053 and ENT-052. available_balance checked at PH-080. AccountDebited event triggered after settlement.

referenced_existing_entities.name: MortgageAccount
referenced_existing_entities.usage: Linked to CHAPSPaymentExecution (ENT-052) when is_mortgage_completion_payment = true. SVC-002 consumes MortgageCompletionPaymentConfirmed (EVT-112) to update MortgageAccount.status.

new_fields.name: chaps_daily_total
new_fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive decimal or 0.00. Max 2dp (GBP). Sum of all CHAPS payments settled from this account in the current UTC calendar day. Reset to 0.00 at UTC midnight. Updated atomically on CHAPSPaymentSettled. Separate from daily_payment_total (FPS).
new_fields.design_note: CHAPS and FPS daily totals are tracked separately to support different monitoring and reporting thresholds. CHAPS has no daily limit (no statutory cap) but the bank may apply internal limits for fraud risk management.
